note: M9 (WP9.5b, plan 7.1 mainPrefix, 7.16 #50): a Sinumerik main block ':20' keeps its prefix when it is renumbered (':110', never 'N110', which would make it an ordinary block and lose the place a block search may start from). A jump names a main block by its own prefix ('GOTOB :20') and an ordinary block by N ('GOTOB N20'), so the two 20s here are two blocks and both jumps are rewritten, each to its own block.
